verdicts.title: Compact minimal hypersurfaces of index one and the width of real projective spaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We characterize the first min-max width of real projective spaces of any dimension. The width is the minimum area over the Clifford hypersurfaces. We also compute the Morse index of the Clifford hypersurfaces in the complex and quaternionic projective spaces.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns min-max width of real projective spaces and Morse index of Clifford hypersurfaces in differential geometry, sharing only the word 'width' with the conjecture but having no connection to Frobenius-Schur indicators or resolution proof complexity.

verdicts.title: A Simple Constructive Proof of Wigner's Theorem
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This expository note presents a constructive proof of Wigner's theorem using only a few basic facts about Hilbert spaces, such as the existence of orthonormal bases and the Fourier decomposition of a vector. Our proof is based on a proof by Steven Weinberg found in the first volume of his series of textbooks on quantum field theory, but differs in a few places for the sake of greater simplicity and rigor.
